description: One dancer walks round the outside of the line into the place behind them.

walkthrough.line: Turn away from the middle and walk round the outside into the place behind you.
walkthrough.teach: On your own, turn away from the middle of the set and walk round the outside of your own line into the place one behind you, still looking the way you were looking. Your hands stay at your sides, and whoever was standing in that place has moved on.
